goal: Prove op-classical: universal eta0,C>0 (dimension-free) such that every row-stochastic Q with ||Q^2-Q||_{inf->inf} <= eta <= eta0 admits a stochastic idempotent E with ||Q-E||_{inf->inf} <= C*sqrt(eta) (sharp exponent 1/2).
frontier: The Kernel/(EX) conjecture: every rank->=3 signed idempotent P with delta<=1/4 has a theta-1/2 actual-row chart U0 with max_s Phi_s(U0) <= C0*delta (C0=1 empirically); equivalently every hidden row vertex with invisible mass > sqrt(delta) has height <= B*sqrt(delta). This one input closes op-classical via HLC <= op-exposed-hull <= op-classical.

arms.desc: Prove the (EX) kernel at rank >=3: every rank->=3 signed idempotent P with delta<=1/4 has a theta-1/2 actual-row chart U0 with max_s Phi_s(U0) <= delta (C0=1). Geometric tie-selection for max-volume charts; charge the two rank-3 bad wedges to the pivot row negative mass.
arms.target: max_s Phi_s(U0) <= C0*delta for a selectable chart; composes with S*<=2Phi+6delta to C_sf=8
arms.kill: a rank->=3 counterexample with min_U max_s Phi_s/delta > 1

arms.desc: Prove lem-dual-localization (frame-free transfer): reproduce ||Ebar||_1 >= H from P^2=P WITHOUT the simplex frame; kill the skinny mu->1 regime where Route B is vacuous.
arms.target: the sigma-cap: prove sigma_v <= 1 - c*tau for hidden top vertices (0<delta<=1/4, W nonempty) — with the af-VALIDATED obs-height-collapse this yields H = O(sqrt(delta)) and closes the Kernel Conjecture; or refute via a rank-growing construction with 1-sigma = O(tau)
arms.kill: an exact instance with sigma -> 1 at small delta and H > B*tau (then the collapse route dies and the campaign pivots to arm A/(EX))

arms.desc: Repair the local-linear-law assembly: combine the four audited variety lemmas into H <= C_loc*delta near the Hognas-Mukherjea locus via nearest-branch recoding.
arms.target: H <= C_loc*delta assembled from the variety lemmas without the 12.8-128x blowup

arms.desc: Global gap via Hognas-Mukherjea Thm 1.12 + the transverse coefficient tax sum_j (P_usj)+ * sum_{t!=s} (-a_t(j))+ <= C_mu*delta; signed quantitative Baake-Sumner stability.
arms.target: the transverse coefficient tax bound, closing displacement->face->L4->global

arms.desc: Lojasiewicz/error-bound route: frame the linear law as a semialgebraic error bound (Hoffman 1952, Luo-Pang 1994) and/or quantitative stability of norm-one (contractive) projections (Douglas-Ando).
arms.target: an error-bound modulus giving the sqrt(delta) distance
